name: Nishinoomote (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Nishinoomote city emblem in blue: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised letter W with a downward triangle.
history: Municipal flag of Nishinoomote, a city in Kagoshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 October 1958; the emblem dates from 1 October 1955.

features.role: Nishinoomote city emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised letter W with a downward triangle
